metadata.name: Homarr v2
metadata.description: Homarr v2 dashboard. This is a new app, separate from Homarr v1. The default SQLite database moves by copying /appdata and keeping the same SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. An external PostgreSQL database is not in /appdata; set the same DB_DIALECT and DB_URL on this app. MySQL is no longer supported; convert existing MySQL data to SQLite before starting v2. Not compatible with legacy Homarr (v0.x) data without migration.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environment_variables.description: 64 character hex string. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep the v1 key if you copy its appdata.

environment_variables.name: DB_DIALECT
environment_variables.description: Database dialect. Leave sqlite unless v1 used an external PostgreSQL database, in which case set postgresql.

environment_variables.name: DB_URL
environment_variables.description: Database URL. Leave the SQLite default, or set the same PostgreSQL URL used by Homarr v1. Copying /appdata does not copy an external database.

ports.description: Container Port: 7575 (host port 7576 to avoid conflict with Homarr v1)

before_install.en_us:
NEW APP - HOMARR V2

This is a NEW app, separate from 'homarr-v1' (v1.63.0) and from 'homarr' (v0.16). Both can run at the same time.

FOR NEW USERS:
- Install this app for new Homarr 2 deployments
- Set SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY to a 64 character hex string from: openssl rand -hex 32
- The Compose file reads that variable. An empty value in the file does not count as a key
- Web UI is on host port 7576

FOR HOMARR V1 USERS:
- Do NOT uninstall your existing 'homarr-v1' app until this one works
- SQLite (the default) lives in /appdata. Copy that directory into this app's appdata volume
- Set SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY to the v1 key. A new key makes encrypted secrets unrecoverable
- An external PostgreSQL database is not inside /appdata. Set DB_DIALECT=postgresql and the same DB_URL used by v1. Homarr migrates that database on startup
- MySQL is not supported. Convert MySQL data to SQLite before starting v2

Migration: https://homarr.dev/blog/2026/09/03/homarr-2.0/
